package steps

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"os/exec"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

//truebdd:concept when "doubling"
func concept49c5ece16061081405dd19dacacf9182109378be8a0f1d472e9711fff19b790b(state *State, args []string) error {
	// The declared public interface (docs/architecture/calc-cli.yaml) says the
	// double command is run as `go run ./services/calc double VALUE` from the
	// host root and answers with the doubled integer and a newline on stdout.
	// The Go test binary runs in tests/calc, so the host root is two levels up.
	const (
		hostRoot = "../.."
		pkgPath  = "./services/calc"
		command  = "double"
	)

	cmd := exec.Command("go", "run", pkgPath, command, args[0])
	cmd.Dir = hostRoot
	// cmd.Env stays nil so the process inherits this run's Go build cache and
	// temporary directory instead of creating a separate one.
	var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
	cmd.Stdout = &stdout
	cmd.Stderr = &stderr
	if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("the Owner doubles %s: go run %s %s %s: %w: %s", args[0], pkgPath, command, args[0], err, strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String()))
	}

	value, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String()))
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("the Owner doubles %s: %s stdout %q is not an integer: %w", args[0], command, stdout.String(), err)
	}

	// Keep what the command answered, for the then concept "result" to compare.
	state.Program = pkgPath
	state.Value = value
	return nil
}
